runs.text: Israel versus the USA. Twelve numbers. One: size. Four hundred forty five Israels fit in America. Two: thirty three times more Americans. Three: so Israel is thirteen times denser. Four: city dwellers. Israel ninety three percent, America eighty three. Five: forest. A third of America. Israel, under seven percent. Six: median age. Israel twenty nine, America thirty eight. Seven: almost three kids per Israeli woman. America, one point six. Eight: Israelis <<ˈ|l|ɪ|v>> four years longer. Nine: money. America wins, thirty one percent more per person. Ten: Israel spends almost double on research. Eleven: soldiers. Sixteen per thousand Israelis, plus forty five in reserve. America, four. Israel drafts at eighteen. <<h|ɑ|ˈ|m|ɑ|s>> and <<ˌ|h|ɛ|z|b|ə|ˈ|l|ɑ>> sit on its borders. Twelve: Israel is the eighth happiest country. America, twenty third. America is bigger and richer. Israel, younger and happier. Which number surprised you? Part two is on my profile. So, one more time:
